summary: Cemex filed a 6-K reporting that Mexican regulators formalized the release of Cemex Concretos, Cemex Operaciones Mexico and Cemex Innovation Holding as guarantors on its long-term certificados bursatiles: CEMEX 23-2L (MXN 8.5 billion) and CEMEX 26 (MXN 5.5 billion), leaving Cemex Corp. as sole guarantor. The CEMEX 23L notes (MXN 3.0 billion) matured and were repaid October 1, 2026, so their release was not completed. This routine debt-guarantee housekeeping, equivalent to an 8-K, carries no deal terms, board recommendation, or special-situation angle.
